# BOOMiiS Restaurant

> Authentic Nigerian restaurant at No. 47, Adjiringano Road, East Legon, Accra, Ghana. Serves Yoruba and wider Nigerian dishes plus Proudly Ghanaian classics, with indoor dining and an outdoor garden bar. Rated 4.3/5 from 73 Google reviews. Main dishes cost about GH₵86–160.

## Key facts
- Address: No. 47, Adjiringano Road, East Legon, Accra, Ghana
- Phone and WhatsApp: +233 50 638 7636 (also +233 27 290 0911 for calls)
- Email: boomiisgh@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/boomiisgh
- Hours: open until 10:00 pm
- Reservations: yes, via the website form or WhatsApp
- Ordering: pickup or delivery from the online menu at /menu (paid in advance with MoMo, confirmed by the team); also on Bolt Food
- Payment: online orders are paid in advance by Mobile Money (MTN MoMo 024 216 5783 or Telecel Cash 050 638 7636, account name Boomiis Limited); the delivery fee is paid to the rider on delivery
- Order tracking: customers follow their order at https://boomiisgh.com/track with their order number and phone; the team also sends updates on WhatsApp
- Features: outdoor seating, kids' menu, cocktails

## Signature dishes (prices in Ghana cedis)
- Mission's Delight: ofada rice with ayamase sauce, GH₵138
- Buka Style: amala, ewedu, gbegiri and stew, GH₵126
- Many Nations GH: jollof, fried rice, plantain, beef, chicken and coleslaw, GH₵98
- Jollof or fried rice (Ghanaian or Nigerian style) with chicken GH₵109; with peppered fish, beef, goat or turkey GH₵104–150
- Soups: egusi GH₵132, efo riro GH₵144, edikaikong, oha and afang GH₵150, goat meat pepper soup GH₵140
- Proudly Ghanaian: light soup GH₵106, groundnut and palmnut soup GH₵117, palava sauce GH₵120, waakye and stew (ask for price)
- Swallows: eba GH₵8, banku GH₵10, amala and semo GH₵25, pounded yam GH₵35
- Typical main dish: GH₵86–160
